description: Defines the SocketBIOAdapter class, an adapter for converting between StreamSocket and OpenSSL BIO I/O models, including buffer management, asynchronous socket operations, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that bridges StreamSocket asynchronous I/O with OpenSSL BIO interface, managing read/write buffers and signaling readiness via delegate callbacks.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when the socket is ready for read or write operations.

methods.name: HasPendingReadData
methods.description: Checks if there is unread data from the socket.

methods.name: HandleSocketReadResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a socket read.

methods.name: OnSocketReadIfReadyComplete
methods.description: Callback for socket read when ready.

methods.name: HandleSocketWriteResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a socket write.

methods.name: CallOnReadReady
methods.description: Triggers delegate callback when socket is ready to read.

methods.name: GetAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the adapter instance from BIO.

methods.name: BIOCtrlWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO control commands.
